reason: The cited code defines deploy_edge_function as taking arbitrary uploaded files (name/content and related settings) and passing them to e.deployEdgeFunction for deployment to a Supabase project, so it establishes an external write/upload of agent-supplied data. It does not show local host command execution; at most it deploys to a remote Edge Function environment, which is not HOSTEXEC under the given definition. The lines do not show that the tool returns secrets/non-public data, nor do they show the shape or attacker-controllability of the deploy response beyond delegating to an external client, so SECRET and UNTRUSTED are not settled by these lines alone.
